link.confirmation: Activate ${alert.title}? Its reading is run as you first, and whom it tells (${alert.audienceText}) is checked.
Copy ${alert.title}? The copy is yours alone.
Request an evaluation of ${alert.title} now? Its evaluation interval still applies, and a state change notifies whom it tells.
Pause ${alert.title}? It is not evaluated and tells nobody until activated again.
Delete ${alert.title} with its state, its delivery history and its versions? ${alert.audienceText} is no longer told.
